rows.label: tlk42100181_01_msg0001
rows.name: Magomago's grandpa is always busy, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100181_01_msg0002
rows.name:
In other places, lots of people
bring goods, but it's different
here, so it's tough, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100181_01_msg0003
rows.name:
You can't bring goods unless the
important people give permission, mo.
Anything? Anything?

rows.label: tlk42100181_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Hurry up and get dark, mooo!
Grandpa, finish work already, mooo!
